title: Analog Input (Single Sample)
text: Acquire single sample from multiple analog channels of data acquisition device, 2 outputs, {Number of ports} sets Number of output data ports 1 for all channels; {Device}, {Channels} sets the device channel selection and configuration options depend, {Sample time} sets the block execution rate and {Output timestamp} adds timestamp output port. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Device
params.values: Device from which you want to acquire data

params.name: Channels
params.values: Device channel selection and configuration options depend on device

params.name: Number of ports
params.values: Number of output data ports 1 for all channels | 1 per channel
